competitive_baselines.primary_data: ten frozen two-work-held-out folds and five deterministic masks
competitive_baselines.selection_data: five development leave-one-work-out folds and five deterministic masks

mass_constrained_composition.rule: hold observed ratios fixed and close predicted hidden ratios to the remaining mass

near_duplicate_sensitivity.rule: exclude a formula if its aromatic material set has Jaccard >= 0.8 with any formula from another work group
